# B2P International

> B2P International is an advertising agency based in Thrissur, Kerala. It provides mobile LED advertising, event LED wall rentals, lookwalker promotions, vehicle branding and related services across Kerala.

For booking and campaign inquiries, call +91 85899 09034 or email info@b2pinternational.com.

## Services

- [LED Van Advertising](https://www.b2pinternational.com/led-van-advertising): Single-Sided, Double-Sided and Triple-Sided LED Vans, plus the 3-Side LED Truck and 3-Side Hydraulic LED Van.
- [LED Wall Rental](https://www.b2pinternational.com/led-wall-rental): Indoor and outdoor LED displays for events, launches and stage backdrops.
- [Lookwalker Advertising](https://www.b2pinternational.com/lookwalker-advertising): Street-level promotions for retail, events and exhibitions.
- [Vehicle Branding](https://www.b2pinternational.com/vehicle-branding): Wraps and graphics for commercial vehicles and fleets.
- [All Services](https://www.b2pinternational.com/services): Includes video production, creative design, printing, signage and outdoor advertising.
